name: Coherent Corp.
key_signal: COHR has crashed 27% in the last month and sits ~24% below its 50-day SMA with MACD deeply negative (-8.4), a sharp reversal from its prior 50% six-month rally.
thesis: Coherent remains a leveraged play on AI-datacenter optics and laser demand, with revenue growth of 20.5% and operating margins expanding to 13.6% from a low base, and 22 analysts still rate it a consensus 'buy' with forward PE of just 33.7x versus a growth rate that could justify a premium if execution stabilizes. The stock is still above its 200-day SMA (246.9) and has a golden cross intact, so long-term trend followers could view this pullback as a buyable dip within a structurally intact uptrend, especially with RSI at 33 flagging oversold conditions that historically precede short-term bounces.
bear_case: The magnitude and speed of the drawdown—down 27% in a month and 15% over three months after a 51% six-month run—suggests a genuine fundamental disappointment (likely guidance or margin/FCF concerns) rather than routine profit-taking, and negative free cash flow of -$198M alongside a trailing PE of 131x and ROE of just 4.7% show the market may have been pricing perfection that is now unwinding; with beta over 2.0 and 91% annualized volatility, any continuation of the current downtrend (price now decisively below the 50-day SMA at 365 with accelerating negative MACD) could easily overshoot toward the 200-day SMA near 247 or lower before finding support, and a broken 50-day/price relationship after a golden cross often precedes further mean reversion rather than immediate recovery.
